notes:
— Background: programmatic ad exchange, house-built encoder + reranker pipeline. Tight p95 SLAs during auctions.
— Primary ask: Replace in-house reranker for personalization at bidder hop without increasing tail latency or cost.
— Perf constraints: target 800 RPS sustained for peak campaigns, p95 <= 75ms end-to-end for rerank RPC, cold-start p99 budgeted at 250ms.
— Cost sensitivity: high — want to cut per-request model cost vs current fp16 GPU inference by 35–50% via batching/quantization/caching.
— Model preferences: open to Llama-deriv/Redwood-verified 30B variants; want quantized int8/4-bit options and fallback smaller models for overflow.
— Routing/fallback needs: region-aware routing (NA primary, EU fallback), auto-fallback to cheaper quantized variants under capacity pressure.
— Caching: interested in prefix/KV reuse across similar impressions and cross-request KV cache to avoid re-encoding shared context.
— Batching: need guidance on batch size trade-offs for <75ms p95; willing to accept micro-batching if no p95 regressions.
— Security/compliance: SSO + SAML, SOC2 attestation, audit logs for inference requests, KMS integration for keys, data residency assurances for EU campaigns.
— Quote from CTO: "We cannot trade off tail latency for cost — both must improve or be neutral."
— POC ask: Redwood to run side-by-side perf runs vs in-house with supplied replay (100k auction events), evaluate throughput, p50/p95/p99, cost per 1M requests; include variants: batch=1, batch=8, quant=fp16/int8/4bit; submit perf run report + config suggestions.
— Documents: shared pricing deck + security questions in Drive; legal requested KMS diagram.
— Internal champion: Head of ML infra (Priya Menon).
— Sales angle: large ad spend potential; will push to Reserved Dedicated if PoC shows parity/cost improvement.
— Notes style: shorthand/fragment-heavy; lots of follow-ups needed on SAML audit and benchmark scheduling.
